div.div: وِقْرٌ A load, (S, A, Msb, K,) in a general sense, (A, K, TA,) whether heavy or light or moderate, (TA,) of a mule and of an ass and of a camel; (Msb;) or mostly of a mule and of an ass; that of a camel being mostly termed وَسْقٌ: (S, TA:) or a heavy load: (A, K:) or a weight that is carried upon the back or head: (TA:) pl. أَوْقَارٌ. (A, K.) You say, جَآءَ يَحْمِلُ وِقْرَهُ He came carrying his load [&c.]. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
